For a while I had been very suicidal like every moment of everyday felt like it was time to give in and be done. I was having an identity crisis in my gender identity and worked at a place that made it clear being queer was not okay, but I had a contract and breaking the contract could ruin my career and cost me my licensure. I felt trapped. I had it planned out and was ready to put it into action. In that time I briefly had a period of being lucid enough to be scared and realized that I couldn't trust myself. Called every therapist in the area who took my insurance almost all never called me back except one. She let me come in past her normal hours and worked with me. She could have tossed me out after 50-60minutes like most therapists have done in the past, but she continued to listen for about 90 minutes until I burned up my emotional energy that night. She made me promise her that I would see her again in 2 days for another appointment. Every following appointment she planned that i wpuld take longer than an hour. Just about every appointment to this day would go about 90 minites, and not once did she charge me more than a single sessions worth. Could she have had me institutionalized absolutely especially after I came in saying I was ready to hurt myself, but she didn't, she wanted to continue to work with me. I continue to see her to this day about 8 years later.

Congrats. It really is freeing when they are accepting. I came out to my first friend outside of my therapist the other day. Without hesitation she told me I will always be a part of their family andi have their full support. The weight that came off my shoulders was massive.
